stem: Voltmarkt's budget table has one row per channel and month, and its spend table one row per channel and day. An analyst joins the two on channel and month, then sums the budget and the spend for each month. What goes wrong?

options.text: The budget repeats on every daily row, so its sum is far too high
Days without spend drop out, so the summed budget comes out too low
Sums give the same total at any grain, so the result is right as it is
Daily spend is rounded to cents, so the variance is off by a few euros
